title: Superhuman header
description: A sticky white bar 67px high with a hairline underneath: the lockup at the left, six regular-weight nav links (those with menus carry a thin chevron) beside it, and a quiet 'Contact sales' link with a bordered 'Sign in' pill at the right. On phones: the lockup and a menu button that opens a dropdown list. Links and the pill ring deepen on hover over 0.2s.
notes: sticky at the top of its container: place it as the first child of the page
